briefing: An Army plan to detonate Iowa explosives proceeds despite a court order, and COP31 climate talks collapsed over fossil fuels. President Trump told federal contractors to clear replies to Congress. Google staff joined protests over AI in school search, and Signal limited mobile screenshots. UK energy bills are set to jump in January, and Medicare open enrollment ends Dec. 7. In Idaho, San Diego State upset Boise State 22-20.
